violated_contract: Every durable pending queue entry must retain a discoverable dispatch owner, including across duplicate admission, active completion and expiry retirement. A lost immediate kick must not remove its recovery path.
canonical_prevention: Use one transactional owner-creation primitive for admission and repair with consistent owner-first read order. Retain fencing epochs on release, transactionally remove empty owners from the hot reconcile range by omitting reconcile_at, and atomically wake them on admission. Reconcile missing owners from a bounded rotating pending scan with a configurable staggered deadline honored by fallback claims and waiting retirement. Cover admission/release/parking contention, monotonic epochs, a stuck lease behind more than 300 empty owners, idempotent staggered repair, and flag-off idle-owner behavior.
